title: Natural degree of a binary monic polynomial
statement: For every natural number $\ell$ and every coefficient vector $a\in\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$, the polynomial $X^\ell+\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}a_iX^i$ has natural degree $\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a vector of $\ell$ coefficients in $\mathbb{F}_2$
